kernel_config.srqfm_topology_note: SRQFM uses linear (i,i+1) connectivity to match the published EuroSAT SRQFM in scripts/run_eurosat_experiment.py.  All-to-all on n_q=8 causes severe kernel concentration and is not the reference SRQFM topology.

pca8.n5_power_note: n=5 seeds; two-sided Wilcoxon p_raw floor is 0.0625 (=2/32). No pair can clear Holm-corrected alpha=0.05 at this seed count. Per-seed McNemar (n=500) and pooled bootstrap (n=2500) provide higher-power complementary tests.

physics8.n5_power_note: n=5 seeds; two-sided Wilcoxon p_raw floor is 0.0625 (=2/32). No pair can clear Holm-corrected alpha=0.05 at this seed count. Per-seed McNemar (n=500) and pooled bootstrap (n=2500) provide higher-power complementary tests.
